Helvetia's quality agreement requires every logger on a GDP shipment to carry a valid calibration certificate and be recalibrated at least every 12 months.
Helvetia placed the 14 units in quarantine and treats the matter as a major observation under its own SOP.
Helvetia requests a CAPA response from Korvane no later than 18 October 2024 and confirmation that the 12-month recalibration cycle applied to every KC-Tag 4 delivered since the start of 2024.
Helvetia's team audits Korvane on 5 November 2024 and the extension of cooperation depends on a satisfactory response.

Dolina Warzyw's KC-Hub 200 in Gniew stopped talking to Tidewalk on 19 September 2024 between 14:05 and 15:03, 58 minutes.
During the Gniew outage twelve containers of cauliflower were on the yard and nobody called or e-mailed the customer.
